preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.split()) and len(stdin.split()) == 2
preconditions.description: stdin contains exactly two integers n and m separated by whitespace, where 1 ≤ n, m ≤ 100.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.splitlines()) == n and all(len(line) == m for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: stdout is a grid of size n × m, where each cell is an uppercase Latin letter.

postconditions.expression: all('A' <= c <= 'Z' for line in stdout.splitlines() for c in line)
postconditions.description: Every cell in the grid is painted with an uppercase Latin letter.

postconditions.expression: all(any((i == j and k == l) or (i != j or k != l) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) for k in range(m) for l in range(m) if stdout.splitlines()[i][k] == stdout.splitlines()[j][l]) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) for k in range(m) for l in range(m) if stdout.splitlines()[i][k] == stdout.splitlines()[j][l])
postconditions.description: For every color in the grid, the set of cells with that color forms one or more squares (connected regions where each region is a square).

postconditions.expression: all(any((i == j and k == l) or (i != j or k != l) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) for k in range(m) for l in range(m) if stdout.splitlines()[i][k] == stdout.splitlines()[j][l]) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) for k in range(m) for l in range(m) if stdout.splitlines()[i][k] == stdout.splitlines()[j][l]) and all(not (i == j and k == l) or (i == j and k == l) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) for k in range(m) for l in range(m) if stdout.splitlines()[i][k] == stdout.splitlines()[j][l])
postconditions.description: Each connected region of the same color forms a square (i.e., the region is a square block of cells).

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i][k] <= stdout.splitlines()[j][l] or (i < j or (i == j and k < l)) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) for k in range(m) for l in range(m) if stdout.splitlines()[i][k] != stdout.splitlines()[j][l])
postconditions.description: The coloring is lexicographically minimal: for any two cells (i, k) and (j, l) where i < j or (i == j and k < l), the color at (i, k) is not greater than the color at (j, l) if they differ.
